summary: Kontoor Brands filed an 8-K under Item 2.01 reporting the November 2, 2026 closing of its previously announced sale of all outstanding shares of The H.D. Lee Company, Inc. to ABG-Storm LLC, an Authentic Brands Group affiliate, under a Stock Purchase Agreement dated May 20, 2026. Kontoor received $750 million cash at closing, subject to customary post-closing adjustments for cash, indebtedness, transaction expenses and net working capital, plus a $250 million earnout over five years tied to Lee's performance. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch earnout achievement and use of proceeds.
